title: The last tourist, 2026
logline: One tourist on the seawall bench from behind, phone down, looking at the bay the way locals do, and at the bench's other end a man in plaid from behind doing the same. The page can't tell them apart and says so by drawing them alike.

panels.composition: A seawall bench from behind with two figures at its ends, a tourist in a fleece and a man in plaid, both with hands in their laps looking at the bay, drawn with the same line.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a seawall bench seen from behind with two figures at its ends, one in a fleece and one in plaid flannel, both looking at a bay with their hands in their laps, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
